articles.summary: XPEL, a global leader in protective films and coatings, will highlight legendary vehicles, live installation demonstrations and host Team Penske driver Josef Newgarden XPEL, Inc. (Nasdaq: XPEL), a global leader in protective films and coatings, will showcase its industry-leading vehicle protection solutions on some of the world's most recognizable and exclusive vehicles at the 2026 Specialty Equipment Market Association (SEMA) Show in Las Vegas, November 3-6, 2026. From a historic Le Mans race car to a one-of-one Bugatti hypercar, XPEL will demonstrate how its products help preserve and protect vehicles ranging from motorsports legends to modern collector masterpieces. At the 2026 SEMA Show, XPEL will highlight a legendary Mazda 787B Le Mans race car, with its iconic paint scheme protected by XPEL ULTIMATE PLUS™ PPF.
